title: Positive Counting Rule for Type-A Schubert Structure Constants
exact_target: Can every ordinary type-A Schubert multiplication coefficient be counted by a single polynomial-time-verifiable family of positive witnesses?

sources.citation: Igor Pak and Colleen Robichaux, Positivity of Schubert Coefficients (2024 preprint; Comptes Rendus Mathématique 363 (2025), 1507–1515).
